_note: Paper-only strategy variants run side by side on the same live data. Edit and save; the bot reloads within a minute and logs the change. Stakes above $10 are clipped in code.

main.desc: Headline bot: model blended 50/50 with market price, 4c min edge, only 90-240s left, asks 20-80c, $1 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5, cap $2 when ask >70c

main_minfill.desc: Same as main, but if the edge-sized bet is under the 5-share minimum, round up to 5 shares when that costs $3 or less

model_early.desc: Pure price model (no market blend), needs 8c edge, only 120-240s left (backtest's best pocket), cap $5

blend_wide.desc: Blend model+market, lower 3c edge, any time from 30s to 240s left, cap $5

legacy_fixed.desc: Control: today's original rules (3c edge, $1 +$1 per 1c, up to $10, any time) but with the fixed probability math

ride_favorite.desc: Like trading by hand: buy whichever side the market favors at 70-85c with 60-120s left, flat $4.50 (smallest bet that meets the 5-share minimum), no model
